pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Jellyfin's FFmpeg build, installed alongside media-video/ffmpeg rather than replacing it. Carries Jellyfin's patch series, notably the tonemap_cuda filter that performs Dolby Vision RPU reshaping in CUDA kernels. That filter is not part of upstream FFmpeg, and Jellyfin only ever emits it on the NVIDIA path, so Dolby Vision Profile 5 cannot be tone mapped on NVIDIA hardware without this build.
The portable upstream binaries are statically linked against everything except glibc and are installed under /usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg, outside PATH, so they cannot shadow or conflict with the system FFmpeg.
